admission_rule: A candidate becomes a Tasks Library record only after human approval of its description, exact robot-configuration applicability, difficulty annotation, private criterion, and required executable scene/observations.
threshold_rule: No numerical threshold from a source benchmark is inherited. Every executable threshold remains unset until separate human review.

candidates.description: Move backward in the robot's initial heading frame, then stop in a stable upright stance.
candidates.adaptation_note: Use the initial-body-yaw frame and the admitted low-level route; no high-level Move call is permitted.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: A reverse translation adds braking and heading control without adding terrain complexity.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted physical state shows sufficient backward displacement, bounded lateral drift, upright motion, and a stable final stop.

candidates.description: Move left in the robot's initial heading frame, then stop in a stable upright stance.
candidates.adaptation_note: Evaluate lateral displacement in the initial-body-yaw frame and synthesize all leg behavior from LowCmd.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Lateral translation requires coordinated stepping while holding forward position and heading.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted physical state shows sufficient leftward displacement, bounded off-axis drift and yaw error, upright motion, and a stable final stop.

candidates.description: Move right in the robot's initial heading frame, then stop in a stable upright stance.
candidates.adaptation_note: Mirror the leftward task semantically, but preserve a separate robot-conditioned execution and evaluation record.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Lateral translation requires coordinated stepping while holding forward position and heading.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted physical state shows sufficient rightward displacement, bounded off-axis drift and yaw error, upright motion, and a stable final stop.

candidates.description: Turn in place to the specified yaw heading and stop upright.
candidates.adaptation_note: The task target is semantic yaw; capability generation must decide how to synthesize it from joint-level commands.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Primarily commands yaw while constraining unintended translation and roll/pitch motion.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted physical state reaches the target yaw with bounded horizontal drift and a stable upright final state.

candidates.description: Track the specified forward, lateral, and yaw velocity command for the requested interval.
candidates.adaptation_note: Command bounds and evaluation windows must be selected for this exact Go2 LowCmd/MuJoCo route rather than copied from training environments.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Simultaneously tracks three planar velocity components over time.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Harness-observed planar linear and yaw velocity remain within approved error limits for the approved fraction of the requested interval while the robot remains upright.

candidates.description: Visit the specified ordered sequence of planar waypoints and finish upright at the final waypoint.
candidates.adaptation_note: Waypoints and their ordering are public task state; any trajectory-follow API remains provenance only.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Requires multiple sequential spatial goals and a stable terminal state.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: The trusted event trace enters every waypoint region in order and ends upright and stopped in the final region.

candidates.description: Stop from the specified ongoing planar motion and settle into a stable upright stance.
candidates.adaptation_note: The initial motion is established by the trusted Harness before capability invocation; StopMove is not callable by the generated implementation.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Requires deceleration and balance recovery from a nonstationary initial state.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state confirms an upright stop within the approved stopping time and distance, followed by a stable dwell.

candidates.description: Adjust to the specified body roll while maintaining support and location.
candidates.adaptation_note: The approved roll range must respect the exact morphology and support constraints; Euler/BalanceAttitude calls are not available to the implementation.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Changes one body attitude axis while constraining translation and support loss.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state reaches the target roll within the approved error while preserving support and bounded horizontal drift for the approved dwell.

candidates.description: Adjust to the specified body pitch while maintaining support and location.
candidates.adaptation_note: The approved pitch range must respect the exact morphology and support constraints; Euler/BalanceAttitude calls are provenance only.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Changes one body attitude axis while constraining translation and support loss.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state reaches the target pitch within the approved error while preserving support and bounded horizontal drift for the approved dwell.

candidates.description: Recover from the specified permitted fallen starting pose to a stable upright stance.
candidates.adaptation_note: Only explicitly admitted initial poses may be used; source robots and self-righting protocols are not assumed equivalent to Go2.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: A large contact-rich whole-body transition whose feasibility depends on the initial-pose set.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: From an admitted fallen initial pose, trusted state reaches and holds the approved upright standing region without prohibited post-recovery contact.

candidates.description: Maintain and recover the specified stance after the declared external planar disturbance.
candidates.adaptation_note: The trusted Harness applies a frozen disturbance; candidate code cannot choose or observe hidden evaluation parameters.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Tests balance recovery from an externally imposed perturbation rather than nominal tracking alone.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: The robot remains nonfallen or returns to the approved stance region within the approved recovery time and drift bounds after the frozen disturbance.

candidates.description: Traverse the specified irregular rough-terrain segment and finish upright in the goal region.
candidates.adaptation_note: Terrain geometry and seeds require new frozen scene assets; source training ranges are not evaluation thresholds.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Irregular support heights require continuing foothold and body stabilization.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state enters the goal region after traversing the frozen terrain segment while satisfying the approved fall, contact, and terminal-stability rules.

candidates.description: Ascend the specified slope and finish upright on its goal platform.
candidates.adaptation_note: Slope geometry and friction must be frozen for the Go2 MuJoCo scene before admission.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Changes gravitational loading and pitch demands throughout locomotion.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state reaches and settles on the goal platform without a fall or forbidden contact.

candidates.description: Descend the specified slope and finish upright on its goal platform.
candidates.adaptation_note: Use a separately reviewed downhill task because braking and impact risks differ from ascent.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Requires controlled braking and posture regulation under downhill loading.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state reaches and settles on the lower goal platform without a fall or forbidden contact.

candidates.description: Traverse the specified staircase and finish upright on its goal platform.
candidates.adaptation_note: Stair direction, geometry, friction, and collision assets must be frozen; ascent and descent may be split during human review.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Repeated discrete elevation changes impose foothold, clearance, and impact constraints.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state crosses every required stair transition and settles in the goal region without a fall or forbidden contact.

candidates.description: Traverse the specified sparse box-and-step field and finish upright in the goal region.
candidates.adaptation_note: Requires a new frozen scene asset and an approved public representation of obstacle geometry for the no-camera configuration.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Irregular discrete supports require clearance, foothold selection, and balance.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state reaches the goal through the frozen field while satisfying the approved obstacle-contact, fall, and terminal-stability rules.

candidates.description: Weave through the specified ordered poles and stop upright in the goal region.
candidates.adaptation_note: Adapt the Barkour weave-poles concept to Go2 dimensions; do not inherit Barkour geometry, scoring, or timing. The current no-camera configuration needs an approved public pole-state representation.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Requires repeated direction changes, collision avoidance, and ordered progress through a constrained path.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: The trusted trace passes the poles in the approved order and side sequence, avoids forbidden pole contact, and ends upright in the goal region.

candidates.description: Traverse the specified A-frame obstacle and stop upright in the goal region.
candidates.adaptation_note: Adapt only the obstacle concept. Go2-specific geometry, friction, observation, and safety limits require separate review and scene admission.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Combines steep ascent, crest transition, descent, and terminal balance.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted state crosses the frozen A-frame route and settles in the goal region without a fall or forbidden off-obstacle contact.

candidates.description: Cross the specified broad-jump obstacle and land in a stable upright state in the goal region.
candidates.adaptation_note: The source tasks use different robots and perception. Go2-specific gap geometry, takeoff state, landing surface, and safety envelope must be independently piloted and approved.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: A dynamic flight and landing task with tight safety and morphology dependence.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted contact and pose evidence confirms crossing the frozen obstacle without prohibited gap contact and a stable upright landing in the goal region.

candidates.description: Cross the specified high obstacle and land in a stable upright state in the goal region.
candidates.adaptation_note: Extreme Parkour establishes a task concept, not Go2 feasibility. The current robot configuration lacks the paper's front depth camera, so admission requires an approved public geometry representation or a distinct sensor configuration.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Highly dynamic clearance and landing behavior with strong perception and morphology dependencies.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: Trusted contact and pose evidence confirms complete obstacle clearance and a stable upright landing in the goal region.

candidates.description: Complete the specified ordered quadruped agility course and stop upright in the final goal region.
candidates.adaptation_note: This is a future compound task. Each obstacle, transition, observation, safety rule, and Go2-specific scoring rule must first be separately admitted.
candidates.difficulty_rationale: Composes multiple locomotion and agility skills with ordering and transition constraints.

private_criterion_template.success_statement: The trusted event trace completes every frozen course element in order and ends in a stable upright state in the final goal region.
